mission: Establish a genuine reproducible artifact path for the canonical NayaNET React/Vite Hub.
human_intent: Build the exact current main React Hub, fingerprint an immutable artifact, and make artifact transport to the existing AppDeploy target possible without recreating the Hub.
naya_understanding: The AppDeploy source adapter cannot be trusted as the canonical React build environment. The repository must own the build and artifact provenance chain.
authority: GitHub main canonical source; existing NayaNET React/Vite Hub architecture; NAYA_ACTION_V1 governance.
constraints: Do not create a competing Hub
Do not promote AppDeploy READY to canonical React proof
plan: Harden canonical GitHub Actions artifact workflow
Transport artifact to existing AppDeploy target
actions: Inspected NAYANET/HUB package/build surface and existing canonical React workflow.
Updated .github/workflows/naya-canonical-react-build-handoff.yml to typecheck, build, fingerprint, package, and upload the canonical artifact.
Created scripts/build-canonical-react-hub.sh to run existing PIS projection, preserve cognition runtime, execute Vite, and mark the canonical artifact.
Triggered repository-side execution by committing the build adapter.
observations: The prior AppDeploy build failed at npm run build without exposing its underlying compiler log.
A repository-owned build path is therefore required before artifact transport can be proven.
The accessible GitHub execution plane does not expose workflow-dispatch mutation or an AppDeploy artifact-upload API capable of accepting a ZIP directly.
Current canonical control-plane state also identifies an independent Assistant-lane Cloudflare/runtime boundary; that boundary is not silently substituted here.

previous_behavioral_run.first_failure: qa_naya_context_boot.py reported unexpected manifest schema; this was unrelated to React artifact build and did not produce the requested React artifact.

result: Canonical GitHub artifact pipeline is now defined in repository and build adapter exists; immutable artifact production and AppDeploy transport remain unproven until a fresh build run completes and an artifact transport surface is available.
lesson: Artifact provenance must be established before deployment equivalence. A ready deployment is not evidence that the canonical React artifact is running there.
next_action: Execute the canonical artifact run, obtain the immutable GitHub Actions artifact and hashes, then use an authorized artifact-capable AppDeploy transport surface to deploy that exact artifact and verify runtime.
